applicabilityBasis.summary: wiTRY is an ERC-4626 receipt for staked iTRY with a proportional pool claim. Yield increases the iTRY quantity redeemable per wiTRY, so the wrapper unit is a value-accruing position rather than a fixed Turkish-lira payment unit. Underlying iTRY terms and its issuer are assessed separately; iTRY being backed by money-fund shares does not itself make wiTRY a registered fund share.

genius.notes: Brix website terms and privacy policy identify wiTRY Limited as website operator/data controller in the British Virgin Islands. They do not establish the legal issuer or redemption obligor for wiTRY; issuerEntity is intentionally omitted. The iTRY Token Terms identify iTRY Limited as the underlying iTRY issuer, not the wrapper issuer. Staking documents contain a coming-soon notice while the product page presents wiTRY as live; this lifecycle discrepancy does not change the documented appreciating-share mechanics. No independent PPSI status is inferred from underlying assets or custody arrangements.
